Game Overview

In Funny Spider, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a charming journey with Funny Spider, a delightful arcade adventure where precision and timing are your best friends. Scale towering heights as an adorable arachnid, skillfully leaping past obstacles. Simple controls and captivating animations create a fun and challenging experience for everyone. Aim for new heights and enjoy the climb!
